Ui.Script:
-- The bar's colour at 0 and at the meter's max, linear between. BENILLA_NOISE_EMPTY = { 1, 0.82, 0 } BENILLA_NOISE_FULL = { 1, 0.1, 0.1 } -- The glow's pulses on a rise, and the seconds they take together. BENILLA_NOISE_PULSES = 2 BENILLA_NOISE_GLOW_TIME = 0.6 -- Seconds the cause line shows, and how many of the last of them it fades over. BENILLA_NOISE_LINE_TIME = 4 BENILLA_NOISE_LINE_FADE = 1
-- The Boss Bar 4 px under the Noise Bar while it is up, 40 px under the screen top without it. function BenillaNoiseBar_PlaceBossBar() if not BenillaBossBar then return end BenillaBossBar:ClearAllPoints() if BenillaNoiseBar:IsShown() then BenillaBossBar:SetPoint("TOP", "BenillaNoiseBar", "BOTTOM", 0, -4) else BenillaBossBar:SetPoint("TOP", "UIParent", "TOP", 0, -40) end end
-- The colour at `fill` of the way from empty to full. local function BenillaNoiseBar_Colour(fill) local e, f = BENILLA_NOISE_EMPTY, BENILLA_NOISE_FULL return e[1] + (f[1] - e[1]) * fill, e[2] + (f[2] - e[2]) * fill, e[3] + (f[3] - e[3]) * fill end
-- The bar from `GetPhaseMeter()`, hidden with the glow and the line when no meter is up. function BenillaNoiseBar_Paint() local name, stacks, max, endIcon = GetPhaseMeter() if name then BenillaNoiseBarName:SetText(name) BenillaNoiseBarIcon:SetTexture(endIcon) BenillaNoiseBarMeter:SetMinMaxValues(0, max) BenillaNoiseBarMeter:SetValue(stacks) local fill = 0 if max > 0 then fill = math.min(stacks / max, 1) end BenillaNoiseBarMeter:SetStatusBarColor(BenillaNoiseBar_Colour(fill)) BenillaNoiseBar:Show() else BenillaNoiseBar.glowStart = nil BenillaNoiseBar.lineStart = nil BenillaNoiseBarGlow:Hide() BenillaNoiseBarCause:Hide() BenillaNoiseBar:Hide() end BenillaNoiseBar_PlaceBossBar() end
function BenillaNoiseBar_OnEvent() BenillaNoiseBar_Paint() if arg1 and BenillaNoiseBar:IsShown() then local now = GetTime() BenillaNoiseBar.glowStart = now BenillaNoiseBar.lineStart = now BenillaNoiseBarGlow:SetAlpha(0) BenillaNoiseBarGlow:Show() BenillaNoiseBarCause:SetText(arg1) BenillaNoiseBarCause:SetAlpha(1) BenillaNoiseBarCause:Show() end end
-- The glow's pulses, each rising from 0 to full and back, and the line's fade. function BenillaNoiseBar_OnUpdate() local now = GetTime() if BenillaNoiseBar.glowStart then local t = now - BenillaNoiseBar.glowStart if t < BENILLA_NOISE_GLOW_TIME then local p = t / BENILLA_NOISE_GLOW_TIME * BENILLA_NOISE_PULSES p = p - math.floor(p) BenillaNoiseBarGlow:SetAlpha(1 - math.abs(2 * p - 1)) else BenillaNoiseBar.glowStart = nil BenillaNoiseBarGlow:Hide() end end if BenillaNoiseBar.lineStart then local t = now - BenillaNoiseBar.lineStart local fadeFrom = BENILLA_NOISE_LINE_TIME - BENILLA_NOISE_LINE_FADE if t >= BENILLA_NOISE_LINE_TIME then BenillaNoiseBar.lineStart = nil BenillaNoiseBarCause:Hide() elseif t > fadeFrom then BenillaNoiseBarCause:SetAlpha(1 - (t - fadeFrom) / BENILLA_NOISE_LINE_FADE) end end end
